findings.title: Bad debt disappears without a resolving transition
findings.evidence: The input has debt 1000 and collateral valued at 400. The sole step recognizes a 600 loss. Expected debt becomes 0. There is no collateral sale, 400 settlement, authorized write-off, or successor liability. The erasure=false flag does not establish discharge. The mutation rejects a missing loss label, but permits this positive case with unsupported debt deletion.
findings.materiallyMissingObligation: A complete distinction between recoverable debt, recovery cash, authorized loss allocation, and the surviving or explicitly resolved borrower duty. This is a design contradiction, independent of protocol source availability.

findings.title: Redemption final observations contradict the listed claim step
findings.evidence: Both traces list claim 40 USDC as their last step. Expected status remains Claimable, claimable remains 40, and sharesLocked remains 100. They also assert residualShares 60 without a share-to-asset conversion. The held-out input includes claimedFloor 9500, which the expected observations never check. The intent trace explicitly drops that floor. Its map marks token transfers inapplicable despite the claim payment.
findings.materiallyMissingObligation: A coherent post-claim asset/share/request state, independently derived conversion, retained net intent constraint, and double-claim rejection. An unknown exchange-rate function cannot justify the asserted numeric residual.

findings.title: Refinance does not account for funding, financed fees, or gross authority
findings.evidence: The old creditor receives 50000 before new debt creation, but no payer balance or bridge funding exists in the input. New debt is 50050 with a financed 50 fee. tokensMoved lists only 50000 USDC and 20 WETH, with no fee recipient or lender disbursement. authorityRemaining leaves fee charging conditional on whether fees are transfer-like. The 1000 transfer cap is not bound to a defined actor or debit domain. Collateralization is asserted without prices or a numeric toy ratio. workRemaining 1008 has no charged-step derivation.
findings.materiallyMissingObligation: Complete authorized gross transfers, funding origin, financed-fee allocation, independently bounded debt authority, observable collateral prefixes, and exact residual authority/work. Protocol parameters can remain unfrozen while a generic oracle supplies its own explicit assumptions.

findings.title: Concentrated-liquidity and iterative-AMM examples do not derive the named mechanisms
findings.evidence: Concentrated liquidity lists ticks and liquidity but no input amount, price representation, output amount, position change, or fee-growth calculation. It asserts a fee of 1 and floor-on-zeroForOne without a quantity-specific formula or reverse-direction result. The iterative case supplies D=1000,1008,1004,1004 without an invariant function, recurrence, derivative, or reserves. Its mutation names cap 8 but gives no concrete nonconvergent capped run.
findings.materiallyMissingObligation: Independently derived bounded numeric examples for tick/position/fee rounding and AMM convergence, including discriminating rejection inputs. Arbitrarily chosen output sequences are insufficient even for generic design oracles.

findings.title: Composition examples omit complete economics and contradict their observation maps
findings.evidence: Sequential pays 10 and 20 without account states or funding. Disjoint parallel says move X and Y without quantities. Shared-state interleaving names a swap and liquidity addition without pool states that distinguish the orders. Atomic synchronization borrows 50, swaps 50, and repays 51 without proceeds or fee funding. Asynchronous messaging uses timeout=bounded and refund prose without a numeric lock, deadline, or fee. All five maps mark tokens inapplicable. The atomic map also marks debt and fees inapplicable, although its trace has both. The shared-state map excludes its trace fee.
findings.materiallyMissingObligation: Five concrete positive and negative compositions with consumed/produced states and histories, account effects, conflict observations, exact authority/work partitions, and failure residuals. Operator-contract prose alone does not establish these finite traces.

findings.title: Work and residual preservation are asserted without complete finite accounting
findings.evidence: Recurring workRemaining is the string not reset. No work costs or remaining closure reserve are derived. Partial fill has zero fees, no actual refund, no account balances, and no outstanding duty beyond a consumed-authority record. Its map says residual fill rights persist while the trace gives no surviving rights state after cancellation. Composition carries no numeric work split or join accounting. Default bounds are repeated without connecting trace operations to consumed resources.
findings.materiallyMissingObligation: Concrete lifetime/work/closure arithmetic and surviving duties for partial progress, cancellation, exhaustion, split, and continuation. The no-refresh and no-erasure requirements need discriminating observations, not only boolean declarations.

findings.title: Shared-vault settlement is an unexplained zeroing of deltas
findings.evidence: The hook changes token1 delta from -9 to -10. The final step says settle to 0, but gives no vault inventory, participant balances, settlement transfers, fee recipient, or delta-sign convention. Thus the final zero cannot distinguish real settlement from resetting a counter. The negative example checks nonzero final delta, not unsupported zeroing.
findings.materiallyMissingObligation: A complete pre/temporary/final accounting derivation that binds permitted hook effects to actual asset settlement and fee allocation.

findings.title: Observation authentication, custody, and recovery remain labels rather than concrete cases
findings.evidence: The contingent claim names freshness <=1h and anchor O9 but has no observation/current timestamps or authenticated payload binding. Insurance pays 8000 without insurer funding or a concrete adjudication record. Async settlement creates a destination claim that is absent from expected observations. Cross-domain recovery shows only successful finality, with recovery unused. The separate async operator refund has no numeric funding. Rejection descriptions do not supply concrete stale, substituted-provenance, late-receive/refund-race, or custody-failure states.
findings.materiallyMissingObligation: Bounded assumed observation records and complete claim/custody/message transitions, including concrete rejection and recovery outcomes. Explicit external-truth disclaimers are correct but do not supply the missing finite expectations.

findings.title: Margin/funding and ordered redemption lack full resulting financial state
findings.evidence: Margin/funding mixes a rejected withdrawal with a withdrawal that may proceed. Expected cash 95 describes availability after a funding hold, not an executed withdrawal. There is no position, margin requirement, settled transfer, or final collateral state. Ordered redemption computes debt residuals correctly but supplies no collateral quantities/prices, received assets, burn/settlement, fees, or account/authority changes.
findings.materiallyMissingObligation: An unambiguous positive execution and full observable result for each mechanism. The arithmetic 100-5=95 and 150=100+50 does not establish an admissible financial transition.

findings.title: Representation paths and footprints do not identify the concrete state/effects under review
findings.evidence: Most representation paths repeat generic stage notes. Many read/write footprints name only the challenge itself with bound 1, or op-name with bound 2. Refinance omits funding accounts and fee recipients. The concentrated footprint does not enumerate its three ticks and position records. Four mandatory claims and genesis/admin inclusion are preserved as names and flags, but no concrete acceptance statement or genesis/admin case binds the complete proposed state/effects.
findings.materiallyMissingObligation: A reviewable source-to-intent-to-plan-to-state/effect/assumption/successor mapping and real bounded resources. Future implementation may remain open, but placeholders cannot support full design-map acceptance.

findings.title: The theorem ledger lacks the required exact proposed definitions
findings.evidence: Definitions mostly list nouns. Assume-guarantee refers to an unspecified derived guarantee and compatibility predicate. Associativity refers to stated observation-order conditions without stating those conditions or the observation equivalence. Type preservation gives expression e type tau and then assigns the complete successor state sigma-prime the same tau without defining a state-typing relation. Conservative extension names D0 but does not define its admission predicate or translation. Evidence refs identify entire files rather than exact definitions.
findings.materiallyMissingObligation: Exact proposed predicates, definitions, bounded domains, compatibility and observation conditions. All eight entries correctly remain proposed with empty axioms and mechanizedEvidence. No mechanized proof is required for this review.
